about: Risky Rails feel presets: the one source for RR_Feel.lua, FEEL_SPEC.md, plots and previews. Format: references/schema.md. Numbers are knobs unless written {v, canon}; colours are @bible.key tokens or neutral #FFFFFF/#000000.

meta.near_depth_note: about half the cab width (tech.units.cab_inside): where near geometry sits from a player's eye

roles.camera: workspace.CurrentCamera; implicit for shake, camkick and fov
roles.screen: full-screen overlay Frame that RR_Feel creates (ScreenGui RR_FeelOverlay, IgnoreGuiInset)
roles.panel: a Frame or CanvasGroup that opens or closes (terminal, results, settings)
roles.ticket: the HUD ticket's moving content (NotificationHud parts.mover); RR_Feel must be its only animator (delete the controller's slide and shake)
roles.stamp: a value stamp or merge badge on a ticket (parts.stamp or parts.badge)
roles.halo: the red halo Frame on the newest crisis ticket (parts.haloRed), designed opacity 1 (BackgroundTransparency 0): the pulse sets min..max of it
roles.cash: TextLabel showing the fare being banked
roles.lamp: the side lamp on the lever console (ui.lever.commit)
roles.report: the Incident Report card on the results screen
roles.report_stamp: the YOU'RE FIRED stamp on the Incident Report (av.vfx.boiler_fail)

shake.about: trauma model: events add trauma, it decays linearly on the feel clock; shake = trauma^power; offsets and angles are max x shake x noise(t x freq)

sustain.about: continuous trauma floors from game state; the sum is capped at shake.sustain_cap; the train never moves, so keep these tiny (identity.pillars.stable_train)

speed.about: floor = gain x Speed / ref; call Feel.setSpeed(speed) on every throttle change

pressure.about: floor = gain x clamp((p - threshold) / (1 - threshold)); p = pressure as 0..1 of the gauge, 1 = redline; numbers are the OQ-013 default

lever.about: drag feel for the two-way lever console: the knob lags the finger (heavy); the detent tick at notch, the commit once at detent (then snap home with an overshoot); a new junction (ctx.fork) re-arms it

a11y.about: reduce motion defaults from GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled; numbers scale a channel, words change it; a channel's own rm beats this table

flash.about: WCAG 2.3.1 three-flash rule, applied to full-screen flashes; the runtime limiter enforces it across stacked events; flashes off skips screen and vignette flashes, element lamps stay

profiles.about: global intensity multipliers per channel type; flashes and hit-stop never go above default (safety caps)

preview.about: mock phone plate for previews only (not a game asset)

ui_button_press.intent: the button gives under the thumb before anything happens
ui_button_press.rm_reads: the button pressed look and the action it starts

ui_button_release.intent: a springy return that confirms the press
ui_button_release.rm_reads: the action the press starts (a panel opens, an order goes in)

ui_panel_open.trigger: a panel opens (supply terminal, results, settings)
ui_panel_open.intent: panels pop in like a stamped card, fast enough never to block play

ui_panel_close.intent: gets out of the way quicker than it arrived

hud_ticket_enter.trigger: a HUD ticket is shown (NotificationController, show alert)
hud_ticket_enter.intent: the ticket slides in from the right edge with a small overshoot and fades up

channels.note: 0.28 s Back Out as in the HUD export (HUDM)

hud_ticket_leave.trigger: a HUD ticket expires or is resolved
hud_ticket_leave.intent: slides back out and is gone; never lingers

hud_merge_bump.trigger: a repeat alert merges into an existing ticket
hud_merge_bump.intent: the count or cash stamp bumps so the repeat is noticed without a new ticket
hud_merge_bump.rm_reads: the count or cash text on the stamp changes

hud_crisis_arrival.trigger: a crisis ticket lands (included by every crisis alert)
hud_crisis_arrival.intent: one hard shake says 'this one is bad', then the halo keeps breathing until it is fixed

channels.note: approximates the HUD export shake (-5, +5, -4, +3 px over 0.5 s, HUDM): starts left, 4 lobes, ends at rest
1.2 s loop as in the HUD export (HUDM); runs until the crisis clears

alert_coal_low.intent: urgent but not a catastrophe: the fuel gauge jumps and the ticket shakes once

alert_pressure_high.trigger: server show alert PressureHigh; pressure sustain rises separately (Feel.setPressure)
alert_pressure_high.intent: the boiler is about to blow: a red pulse at the screen edge, a heartbeat in the hand, the cab starts to rattle

alert_breakdown.intent: something snapped: a jolt through the whole train, then the ticket

alert_passengers_upset.intent: a people problem, not a mechanical one: no camera jolt, the ticket and the hand carry it

alert_junction_ahead.trigger: server show alert JunctionAhead (the junction lamp starts flashing, gameplay.fork.warning_lamp)
alert_junction_ahead.intent: heads up, a bet is coming: a confident tick, not an alarm
alert_junction_ahead.quiet_ok: its weight is the junction_beep and the gantry warning lamp, not camera or haptics

alert_risky_route.trigger: server show alert RiskyRoute after the lever commits risky
alert_risky_route.intent: the multiplier stamp slams down: greedy and funny

channels.note: rest angle -8 deg is the stamp's canon pose (ui.hud.stamp)

alert_fare_banked.trigger: server show alert FareBanked at a station (gameplay.station.bank)
alert_fare_banked.intent: the payoff: the cash stamp lands, the number counts up, a double tick in the hand

channels.note: fraction of the banked amount; the label format comes from ctx (currency naming is OQ-003)

alert_crate_landed.trigger: server show alert CrateLanded when the crate hits the coach roof (gameplay.supplies.flow)
alert_crate_landed.intent: a thump on the roof you feel through the floor

channels.note: the thump from above dips the view; a 0.2 shake here measured 0.4 px (invisible)

alert_crew_joined.intent: information only: the ticket arrives, nothing else

alert_crew_left.intent: information only: the ticket arrives, nothing else

fork_countdown_tick.trigger: each of the last 3 whole seconds of the lever countdown (gantry countdown, gameplay.fork.lever)
fork_countdown_tick.intent: the loudest countdown in the game: the timer bar thumps every second
fork_countdown_tick.quiet_ok: the loudest countdown is the countdown_tick sound (av.feel.fork_loudest); the bar thump only marks it

lever_detent_tick.trigger: the dragged knob crosses the detent (lever.detent), just before the commit
lever_detent_tick.intent: a notch you feel: the lever gives
lever_detent_tick.rm_reads: the knob keeps tracking the finger toward the detent

lever_commit.trigger: the puller's knob passes the detent; plays at once on their client, the server confirms the lock
lever_commit.intent: a heavy clunk that locks the bet: freeze, jolt toward the pulled side, the lamp lights

lever_commit_crew.trigger: the server confirms the route lock; every client except the puller's
lever_commit_crew.intent: everyone feels the points throw under the train

lever_snapback.trigger: the knob is released before the detent (lever.snapback tween runs on the knob)
lever_snapback.intent: nope: the lever springs back with a small wiggle of the console
lever_snapback.rm_reads: the knob returns home (lever.snapback on the knob is state, not reduced)

channels.note: a quick side wiggle; delivered peak 3 px

route_locked.trigger: the route commits (gameplay.fork.lock): the console leaves
route_locked.intent: decision made, get the console off the screen

shovel_coal.trigger: one shovel load lands in the firebox (gameplay.crisis.firebox)
shovel_coal.intent: a chunky thud that makes shovelling satisfying on the 40th load too

repair_fixed.trigger: a breakdown task completes (wrench, wire match)
repair_fixed.intent: relief with a clank: the fix lands

windows_smash.intent: a sharp crack: a white flick and a short shake

coupling_snap.trigger: a coupling snaps and a carriage is lost (gameplay.crisis.coupling)
coupling_snap.intent: the train lurches as the weight goes: pitch forward, a tug of the FOV

boiler_burst.trigger: boiler explosion hard fail (gameplay.crisis.fail_states); the 3-second clip moment starts here
boiler_burst.intent: the biggest hit in the game, slapstick not horror: freeze, bang, blowback, then the camera moment

fired_stamp.trigger: the YOU'RE FIRED stamp lands on the Incident Report after a fail (av.vfx.boiler_fail)
fired_stamp.intent: the punchline: the stamp drops, freezes on contact, the card jumps
fired_stamp.loud_ok: the punchline of the fail sequence, on the results screen after boiler_burst: never beside a crisis

depart.trigger: the whistle blows and the world starts to scroll (gameplay.run.depart); Feel.setSpeed ramps the rumble
depart.intent: the train takes the strain: a slow lean back and a rumble that builds

throttle_notch.intent: a small nod so the crew notices the speed change
throttle_notch.rm_reads: the throttle handle and the speed readout change in the world

station_arrive.trigger: the train stops at the StopMarker (gameplay.run.arrival)
station_arrive.intent: the game exhales: a lean forward as it stops, the view relaxes
